subject: Rebaseline: AcmeCorp POC — scope change & updated success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Parker <jenna.parker@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up & POC plan — AcmeCorp discovery recap

Hi Jenna,

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Recap below so we're aligned and can kick off the POC next week: 

1) Goals / success criteria (initial):
- Generate < 500ms 95th percentile inference latency for the customer-facing suggestion endpoint (up to 8 concurrent users).
- End-to-end cost estimate showing <= $0.08 per 1k tokens for the expected workload profile.
- Achieve >= 85% precision on intent classification test set (provided) across top 10 intents.

2) Proposed evaluation plan / artifacts:
- We (Redwood) will deploy a dedicated POC environment and share a test endpoint + metrics dashboard.
- You (Acme) provide: test dataset (representative logs), intent labels, and a prioritized list of 3 features to validate.
- Weekly check-ins (Wed 30 min) and a mid-POC sync at week 2 to adjust scope.

3) Timeline (target):
- POC start: 2026-11-08
- Midpoint review: 2026-11-17
- Final review & decision: 2026-11-29

4) Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — POC coordination; Camila (Solutions) — technical delivery; Marcus (Trust) — security requests.
- Acme: Jenna — product owner; Mark — procurement point-of-contact.

Next steps: I will share a short POC plan document and a HubSpot deal link with milestones. Please confirm the dataset delivery timeline and whether the 3 prioritized features above look right.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: Acme-POC-plan-v1.pdf (see plan + acceptance criteria)

From: Jenna Parker <jenna.parker@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@acmecorp.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — AcmeCorp discovery recap

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side after internal alignment: 

- We want to add an additional use case to the POC: real-time auto-summarization of customer support chats (we have a separate dataset). This will be lower QPS but sensitive content; we need to validate summary fidelity and redaction behavior.
- Security: we will require a short summary of data retention controls and whether logs can be disabled for POC endpoints. Marcus in our security team will want to see SOC2 or equivalent artifacts.
- Procurement: Mark will need a one-page SOW with dates and list of deliverables for our internal approval.

Can you confirm whether adding the summarization use case will affect the timeline or require additional infra? If it's significant, we may be ok shifting the mid-point review by a week.

Thanks,
Jenna
Product Manager, AcmeCorp
jenna.parker@acmecorp.com

> On Nov 1, 2026, at 15:12, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > (original message recapped above)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Parker <jenna.parker@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — AcmeCorp discovery recap (updated scope)

Thanks Jenna — adding the summarization use case makes sense and is useful to validate. Quick answers and proposed rebaseline below: 

Impact assessment: 
- Technical: Summarization will require an additional evaluation pipeline and evaluation dataset, but it can run against the same POC cluster. We will enable strict logging controls and offer an option to disable persisted logs for the POC.
- Timeline: To incorporate the extra instrumentation and eval, I'd like to propose: 
  - POC start: 2026-11-08 (as planned)
  - Midpoint review: 2026-11-24 (shift +7 days)
  - Final review: 2026-12-06 (shift +7 days)

Updated success criteria (proposed):
- Suggestion endpoint: <= 500ms 95th pct (same)
- Intent classification: >= 85% precision (same)
- Summarization: ROUGE-L >= 0.55 on the provided chat summaries OR manual QA score >= 4/5 on a 20-sample set
- Security: confirmation that logs are not persisted and SOC2 summary reviewed by Marcus

Owners: 
- Redwood: Camila to own instrumentation & evals; Marcus to own SOC2 artifact handoff; Marissa to coordinate milestones + SOW for procurement.
- Acme: Jenna to provide summarization dataset and labeling guidance; Mark to run procurement.

Attached is a revised POC plan (Acme-POC-plan-v2.pdf) that updates the scope, timeline, and acceptance tests. Please review and confirm; I can prepare the one-page SOW for signature once you confirm dates.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Acme-POC-plan-v2.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Parker <jenna.parker@acmecorp.com>, Mark Thompson <mark.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan — AcmeCorp discovery recap (feasibility + SOC2)

Marissa / team — quick feasibility note from the solutions side: 

- We can onboard the summarization use case within the same POC cluster. We'll need the chat dataset by 2026-11-12 to hit the revised midpoint on 11/24. If Acme can't deliver by then, we should postpone the midpoint by another week.
- For redaction/sensitive content, we can enable masking and a no-persist logging config for the endpoints. There will be a small (~10-15%) compute delta while we run redaction pipelines during ingest.
- Marcus: attaching a short SOC2 summary (SOC2-Summary.pdf) for Jenna and Mark to review; Marcus will also arrange a brief security Q&A next Tue.

I'll update the eval harness to include ROUGE and manual QA slots.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf

Folks — procurement reviewed the updated one-page SOW Marissa sent (thanks) and we're good to proceed on the revised timeline. A few administrative notes: 

- We'll sign the SOW by 2026-11-12 and expect Redwood to start the dedicated POC environment on 2026-11-15 (Mark note: this is acceptable on our side).
- Jenna will deliver both datasets (intent logs + chat summaries) by 2026-11-12.
- Marcus, thanks for the SOC2 summary — we'll schedule the security Q&A next week.

Looking forward to the POC — please keep the weekly Wed check-ins.

Best,
Mark Thompson
